We found that the technique used was a factor in our observation of the phases, for example, the butanol solvate and hydrate were not observed after LAG, but we did begin to observe these phases forming under slurry. However, we observed the pentanol under LAG conditions
eventi.note: «the butanol solvate and hydrate were not observed after LAG»: negativo per il butanolo (solvente butanolo; il testo dice «butanol solvate»).

citazioni: Slurries of TMA (500 mg) in each solvent (1 mL) and heated from 20 ◦C to 55 ◦C over 4 h (0.15 ◦C/min) before cooling to 20 ◦C over 2 h (0.3 ◦C/min).

The solvents in which there were diﬀerences were those known solvated forms of TMA, e.g., DMSO [20–22] and pentanol [7] (for LAG) and water [18,19], methanol [9], butanol (for the slurry) [7] (Figures S1 and S2).

We found that the technique used was a factor in our observation of the phases, for example, the butanol solvate and hydrate were not observed after LAG, but we did begin to observe these phases forming under slurry. However, we observed the pentanol under LAG conditions
eventi.note: Sospensione in acqua: si osserva l'idrato noto («we did begin to observe these phases forming under slurry»). Quale idrato non e' detto. Raffreddamento a 0.3 °C/min.

citazioni: This behaviour mimics that of the previously known DMSO trisolvate that also transitions within a matter of minutes to a more stable 1:2 phase.
This mimics the behaviour of the metastable tri-dmsolate where the TMA is hydrogen bonded to DMSO rather than other TMA molecules (XASFAA) [21].
eventi.note: Trisolvato metastabile con DMSO (XASFAA) che passa in pochi minuti a una fase 1:2 piu' stabile: senza condizioni, da un lavoro citato; il tempo e' «a matter of minutes».

citazioni: Single crystals used for single crystal X-ray diﬀraction studies were obtained by slow evaporation from a saturated solution. For all evaporations, the supernatant present in slurried samples (once returned to room temperature, 20 ◦C) was removed and ﬁltered in to clean vials.
Vial caps were loosely placed on the vials to prevent dust ingress, and the vials stored in a fumehood until crystals suitable for diﬀraction studies were obtained.
The crystals from ethanol evaporative crystallization (Figure 2b) were of high quality and we were able to identify a new triclinic unit cell from the diﬀraction data.
preparazioni.note: Evaporazione lenta del sovranatante (filtrato) della sospensione in etanolo, a 20 °C, in vial con tappo appoggiato.

preparazioni.note: Cristalli per la SCXRD a temperatura variabile (raccolta dal National Crystallography Service). Il testo non dice a quale temperatura sia stato misurato per primo il cristallo, quindi non si sa se la crescita e' di LT o HT: a 20 °C ci si aspetta HT. Lo stesso cristallo copre le due fasi.

citazioni: In addition to the slurry and grinding experiments we also performed solution-based crystallization of TMA from the selected solvents. Again, we were able to isolate the known solvated forms of TMA, e.g., methanol, hydrate and dimethylsulfoxide, but we also observed new phases that had not been observed before during the collection of single crystal diﬀraction data.
preparazioni.note: Cristallizzazione da soluzione nei solventi scelti: si isolano i solvati noti (metanolo, idrato, DMSO) e fasi nuove (le tre nuove strutture dell'articolo). Il metodo preciso non e' descritto in questa frase.

descrizioni.testo: tre gruppi acido carbossilico che danno forti interazioni intermolecolari; forma neutra (148 voci CSD)
descrizioni.citazione: The ability to form strong intermolecular interactions through the use of its three carboxylic acid groups gives scientists a great tool to work with for both organic and metal organic framework studies [1–5].
